description: Implementation of IEEE 802.15.4 MAC frame related functions, including frame validation, creation, security handling, and address management within the Zephyr RTOS network stack.

methods.name: ieee802154_validate_fc_seq
methods.description: Validates the Frame Control Field and Sequence number in an IEEE 802.15.4 frame.

methods.name: ieee802154_create_data_frame
methods.description: Constructs an IEEE 802.15.4 data frame with security and addressing.

methods.name: ieee802154_create_ack_frame
methods.description: Creates an acknowledgment frame with specified sequence number.

methods.name: ieee802154_create_mac_cmd_frame
methods.description: Creates a MAC command frame of specified type.

methods.name: ieee802154_mac_cmd_finalize
methods.description: Finalizes a MAC command frame by appending its length.

methods.name: ieee802154_decipher_data_frame
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted data frame if security is enabled.

methods.name: ieee802154_validate_frame
methods.description: Validates the structure and security of an IEEE 802.15.4 frame.

methods.name: ieee802154_compute_header_and_authtag_len
methods.description: Calculates the header length and authentication tag length for a frame.
